versions.changelog:
- Operates Feishu/Lark Custom Bot through the OOMOL `feishu_custom_bot` connector using the `oo` CLI.
- Sends text, image, rich-text post, interactive card, and shared-chat messages through bot webhooks.
- Uses server-side OOMOL credential injection, avoiding direct handling of raw bot tokens.
- Requires inspecting each action’s live schema before building request payloads.
- Treats all message-sending actions as `[write]` operations that require user confirmation before execution.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

## 1.0.1

- Operates Feishu Custom Bot through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI.
- Sends Feishu/Lark custom bot webhook messages without exposing raw credentials.
- Supports text, image, rich post, interactive card, and shared-chat message types.
- Requires live schema inspection before building action payloads.
- Marks all send actions as write operations that need payload confirmation before running.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the `oo-feishu-custom-bot` skill for operating Feishu/Lark custom bot webhooks through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Sends plain text messages, image messages, rich-text post messages, interactive card messages, and shared-chat cards.
- Uses the `feishu_custom_bot` connector via the `oo` CLI, with credentials injected server-side so raw webhook tokens are not handled locally.
- Provides action-level references and schema-first execution guidance for building valid payloads before each connector run.
- Includes safety guidance for confirming write/send operations before posting messages to Feishu.
